class: A new privacy boundary was applied one layer too wide, to data a narrower, already-correct boundary already protected
symptom: output/<job>/pages/*.txt -- the real saved-page recordings replay_guard.py and the test suite depend on for fidelity, and that debugging a live run depends on -- were collapsed to diagnostics.py's <redacted-value> placeholder for nearly every field, heading and answer, discovered while investigating a live run that kept crashing on a Workday Skills search: the saved pages for that exact run could not be read to find out why.
root_cause: PageAgent._save() was changed (P0-B5) to route every page recording through diagnostics.sanitize_snapshot()/write_safe_text(), the same structural projection used for diagnostic/forensic captures. The snapshot _save() receives is always the return value of PageAgent.snapshot(), which already applies perception.hide_secrets() before any caller sees it (f015: 'redact at the one place a page is read, not in each place it is written'). The second pass added no safety a typed secret did not already have, and destroyed fidelity for everything else.
why_tests_missed: tests/test_page_recordings.py was updated in the same commit to assert the new, sanitized output instead of catching the regression -- the test was made to match the bug rather than the bug being caught by the test.
fix: PageAgent._save() writes the snapshot it is given verbatim again, exactly as it did before P0-B5. tests/test_page_recordings.py now asserts raw round-trip fidelity (including a value diagnostics.py's structural sanitizer would have dropped), and a new test asserts the <redacted-value> placeholder never appears in a saved recording.
prevention: A new privacy/sanitization boundary must name exactly which writers it covers before it is wired in, and must never be proven correct by rewriting an existing test's expectation to match its new output -- an existing test changing from a raw-fidelity assertion to a redacted one is itself a signal to stop and ask whether that writer belongs inside the new boundary at all.
